summary: Russian jet drone struck Dnipro railway station killing 13 civilians and injuring 13, marking the deadliest single strike in days. Overnight, Russia launched 112 Shahed drones from multiple directions with Ukrainian air defense destroying 97, while ballistic missile threats emerged from Kursk and Bryansk. Russian ground forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske as Ukrainian drones struck Russian airfields in Volgograd and Bashkortostan.
key_points: Russian jet drone hit Dnipro railway station killing 13 and injuring 13 civilians. (Source: @kpszsu/91228)
Ukrainian air defense destroyed 97 of 112 Russian Shahed drones overnight, including 30 jet variants. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)
Russian drone strikes killed two 15-year-old girls in Chernihiv and two civilians in Kremenchuk residential building. (Source: @eRadarrua/126877)
Russia launched ballistic missile threats from Kursk and Bryansk regions targeting eastern and northern Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/91203)
Polish defense ministry approved transfer of two MiG-29 fighters to Ukraine as part of €50M aid package. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23946)
Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske according to DeepState map updates. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23936)
Ukrainian drones attacked Moscow airports, Mariinovka airbase in Volgograd, and Bashkortostan oil facility. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Kherson region maintains 54-hour silence regime with humanitarian mission in Oleshky observed by US journalists. (Source: @UkraineNow/84956)

sections.executive_summary: Russian jet drone struck Dnipro railway station killing 13 civilians and injuring 13, marking the deadliest single strike in days. Overnight, Russia launched 112 Shahed drones from multiple directions with Ukrainian air defense destroying 97, while ballistic missile threats emerged from Kursk and Bryansk. Russian ground forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka, Luhivske, and Maiske as Ukrainian drones struck Russian airfields in Volgograd and Bashkortostan.

points: Ukrainian air defense intercepted 97 of 112 Russian Shahed drones overnight, including 30 jet-powered variants, with mobile fire groups and electronic warfare units engaging across multiple oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)

Ukrainian drones attacked Russian military targets including Moscow region airports causing flight restrictions, Mariinovka airbase in Volgograd region, and Bashkir Soda Company facility in Sterlitamak, Bashkortostan storing aviation fuel. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)

Poland approved transfer of two MiG-29 fighters to Ukraine, one with expired service life and one still operational, as part of a €50 million aid package including 155mm and 152mm artillery ammunition, 20×102mm rounds for F-16s, and Piorun missiles. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23946)

Kherson region entered second day of silence regime with civilians returning to damaged homes, communal workers operating without mobile fire group cover, and humanitarian mission in Oleshky monitored by four US journalists. (Source: @UkraineNow/84956)

Ukrainian officials condemned Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure, with Zelensky demanding stronger sanctions from EU, US, and G7 following Dnipro railway station strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/84974)

Russian jet drone deliberately targeted Dnipro railway station hitting a civilian electric train and passenger train, killing 13 and injuring 13, with Dnipro city head Boris Filatov confirming direct strike on civilian infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/91228)

Russian Shahed drones struck Chernihiv killing two 15-year-old girls and injuring two others, causing fires in shops, while a separate drone hit a Kremenchuk residential building killing two and injuring 11 including three children. (Source: @eRadarrua/126877)
Russia launched massive drone wave of 112 Shaheds from Orel, Millerovo, and occupied Donetsk, including 40 jet-powered variants, alongside Gerbera and Parodiya decoy drones. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)
Ballistic missile threats detected from Kursk region (Iskander-M) and Bryansk region (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) targeting eastern and northern Ukrainian oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/91203)
Putin rejected ceasefire discussion during meeting with Finnish and Norwegian leaders, instead delivering historical lecture on Slavic origins per Financial Times report. (Source: @UkraineNow/84969)
Russian forces advanced near Vozdvyzhivka and Luhivske in Donetsk sector per DeepState map update on October 29. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23936)
Further Russian gains reported near Maiske in Donetsk direction according to subsequent map revision. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23937)
Intense drone activity over Dnipropetrovsk region with multiple jet drones targeting Pavlohrad, Ternivka, and Dnipro city, including fatal railway station strike. (Source: @kpszsu/91200)
Zaporizhzhia region under drone threat with strike UAV spotted near Vilnyansk heading toward Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @kpszsu/91230)
Ukrainian air defense actively engaging Russian drones over eastern oblasts with confirmed interceptions over Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions. (Source: @kpszsu/91221)
Russian jet drones launched from Chernihiv region transited toward Kyiv oblast via Bobrovytsia, Kozelets, and Nizhyn, triggering air alerts in Kyiv and Brovary. (Source: @kpszsu/91201)
Multiple Shahed drones entered Chernihiv region from Bryansk region, with three passing Snovsk toward Mena and one approaching Chernihiv from south. (Source: @eRadarrua/126835)
Ballistic missile threat from Bryansk region (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) targeting Chernihiv and Kyiv oblasts per monitoring alerts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77605)
Ukrainian air defense intercepted drones over Chernihiv and Kyiv regions with air raid alerts issued and cleared multiple times in Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/126843)
Russian drone strike on Chernihiv killed two 15-year-old girls and caused commercial fires per Chernihiv OVA head Vyacheslav Chaus. (Source: @eRadarrua/126877)

Kherson region maintains 54-hour silence regime with civilians returning to coastal areas, markets and cafes reopening, and communal workers operating without mobile fire group cover. (Source: @UkraineNow/84956)
Humanitarian mission in Oleshky observed by four US journalists with aid delivery planned, both sides reportedly adhering to silence regime. (Source: @UkraineNow/84968)
Russian strike UAV detected near Vilnyansk in Zaporizhzhia region heading toward Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @kpszsu/91230)
No major ground operations reported in southern sector while drone threats persist across Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/91235)
Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian rear targets include Volgograd and Bashkortostan facilities, demonstrating deep strike capability. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Russia launched 112 attack drones overnight including 40 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerberas, and Parodiya decoys from Orel, Millerovo, and occupied Donetsk. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)
Ukrainian air defense destroyed 97 drones (30 jet-powered) with aviation, missile troops, EW units, and mobile fire groups, while 7 drones still airborne at 08:00. (Source: @kpszsu/91189)

Russian jet drones conducted precision strikes on civilian infrastructure: Dnipro railway station (13 dead), Chernihiv shops (2 dead), Kremenchuk residential building (2 dead, 11 injured). (Source: @kpszsu/91228)
Ballistic missile launch threats detected from Kursk (Iskander-M) and Bryansk (Iskander-M/S-300/Tsirkon) regions targeting eastern and northern Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/91203)

Ukrainian drones struck Russian military airfields: Moscow region airports disrupted, Mariinovka airbase in Volgograd region hit, Bashkir Soda Company in Sterlitamak targeted. (Source: @UkraineNow/84966)
Widespread air raid alerts across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions with multiple alert cycles in Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/126843)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying combined drone and ballistic missile campaigns targeting civilian infrastructure across northern, central, and eastern Ukraine, with jet-powered Shaheds enabling precision strikes on transport hubs like Dnipro railway station. The simultaneous ballistic threats from Kursk and Bryansk indicate coordinated pressure on air defense coverage gaps. Russian ground advances near Vozdvyzhivka and Maiske suggest continued offensive operations in Donetsk sector despite high drone expenditure. Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian airfields and industrial facilities demonstrate growing asymmetric capability to disrupt rear logistics. The Kherson silence regime appears fragile and localized, unlikely to signal broader de-escalation given ongoing nationwide attacks.
